data.title: Bitcoin’s Production Cost Is $78,000. What Happens When Miners Lose Money?
data.description: JPMorgan pegs Bitcoin's production cost above its current market price, and miners have already broken records to stay afloat. What built-in network forces determine whether this becomes a prolonged bleed or a setup for recovery?
data.keywords: production costs, JPMorgan, price of Bitcoin, 78,000
